meta.note: NEGATIVE RESULT -- kept as evidence, not as a shippable map. Designed against the density metric rather than the buildable-percentage band: three two-row chambers joined by single-cell connectors, route 29, buildable 49, 1.7 buildable per route cell against crossroads' 4.0. It scores well and it cannot be balanced. The route is fixed by the walls, so every run is the same game: at hpGrowth 1.09 all 200 runs finish with exactly 20 lives (sd 0.0, range 20-20). A distribution with no width crosses zero all at once, which is why difficulty steps 0% -> 95% between growth 1.12 and 1.125 instead of ramping. Five fixes were tested and rejected -- growth rate, sappers, a reshaped wave table, three-row chambers, twin connectors -- see docs/reports/2026-08-07-gauntlet-cliff-balance.md. Do not tune this into the 15-30% band; the only rates that reach it are on the knife edge.
meta.pinch: The connectors at (8,3) and (1,6) are single cells on the only route, so building there would seal the lane and the sim refuses it. This is the first shipped map where that refusal is reachable in a real game.
